decoding.note: llm_uncertainty_bench is LOGPROB-scored (option-letter logits) -> temperature-invariant. verbalized_ece is GENERATION-scored (model writes answer+confidence); decoding pinned (temp-1/seed-1234) for baseline<->trained parity.

llm_uncertainty_bench.metric: (|Y|-SS)/(|Y|-1), |Y|=6; SS = mean conformal prediction-set size at 90% coverage (LAC+APS averaged, ported from uncertainty_quantification_via_cp.py); option logits via candidate_logits over A-F; cal/test split 50/50 seed 42; coverage logged as a check (never the headline)
llm_uncertainty_bench.note: LLM-Uncertainty-Bench (smartyfh/LLM-Uncertainty-Bench); CosmosQA + HellaSwag, 6-option MCQA (E='I dont know', F='None of the above'), demo ids [1,3,5,7,9] removed; 300 published -> 150 test after the 50/50 conformal split. Degenerate floor: uniform -> SS 6 -> 0; oracle -> SS 1 -> 1.0 (validated). SS + coverage are covariates.

verbalized_ece.metric: discrimination x (1 - ECE); discrimination = max(0, 2(AUROC-0.5)); ECE = 10-bin expected calibration error; over confidence (conf>>acc) -> high ECE; constant-confidence -> AUROC 0.5 -> discrimination 0 -> headline 0; answer+confidence parsed from the source vanilla prompt format; per-dataset correctness (numeric / yes-no / TriviaQA alias)
verbalized_ece.note: Xiong et al. (MiaoXiong2320/llm-uncertainty) vanilla verbalized-confidence prompt; SVAMP + StrategyQA + TriviaQA (100 each). n below = #parse-success items (parse_cov 0.98-1.0). FINDING: <=7B verbalized confidence FLOORS the strict headline (non-discriminating + overconfident); kept strict (not softened to gameable 1-ECE) -> only Olmo clears the 0.05 floor; the other 4 are dont_run floor-excluded. acc/ece/auroc/overconf_gap/parse_cov are covariates.

abstentionbench.metric: mean over datasets of F1(should_abstain, abstained), positive class = abstain; abstention detected by a BLIND judge (COCONOT-style criteria, gold/reference lines REMOVED); F1 not recall (always-abstain ~0.67 capped, always-answer 0, oracle 1)
abstentionbench.note: AbstentionBench (Kirichenko et al., Meta) SUBSET: SQuAD2 + SelfAware + KUQ (natively bi-labeled, directly HF-loadable; the full 22-dataset release is loader-blocked under datasets>=4, and its GSM8K/MMLU controls are underspecification-perturbed variants -> OMITTED). Balanced 50 should_abstain + 50 should_answer per dataset, seed 42. Judge = local Qwen2.5-7B parity judge, BLIND (gold stripped). FINDING: <=7B models rarely abstain (abstain_recall 0.03-0.11) -> they answer unanswerable questions -> low macro-F1 (0.05-0.18); 4/5 above the 0.05 floor (only Qwen 0.0496 floors, already excluded by verbalized_ece). over_abstain_rate + abstain_recall are covariates.

sciq_uncertainty.metric: IDENTICAL conformal scorer to llm_uncertainty_bench ((|Y|-SS)/(|Y|-1), LAC+APS @ 90% coverage); on OOD-science SciQ reformatted to the 6-option A-F schema; one-line LLMUncertaintyBench subclass
